decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Body, neck, fretboard, bridge, four strings and four separate tuning machines are all modelled; the top view shows the headstock and tuner layout correctly and the side views confirm a genuinely thin hollow body. Worn wood grain runs continuously around the rim with no UV seam. 8.9k tris.
limitations: Strings are static geometry, so the instrument cannot be posed mid-play.
No maker's label inside the sound hole.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Flared horn is a true thin shell with a modelled interior and central driver, confirmed in the front-on and left views. Pistol grip, trigger, shoulder strap lugs, battery box and a coiled microphone cable are all separate geometry. Red and grey plastics stay cleanly separated at every angle. Only 2.3 MB.
limitations: Coiled cable is in a fixed pose.
Rear control panel markings are generic symbols with no brand.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Octagonal carved frame with pierced geometric roof panels, eight painted silk-look side panels, carved dragon-head corners and eight hanging red tassels. The top and bottom views confirm the roof lattice and base ring are properly closed. Only 7.8k tris for this much ornament.
limitations: Panels are opaque in the inspection render; add translucency for a lit look.
Tassels are rigid geometry and will not sway without a rig.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Small wall-hung spice shelf with a shaped back, hanging hole, two curved shelves and a lower bin. Distressed red paint over bare wood is consistent on front, back and sides. Top and bottom views confirm real board thickness throughout. Only 524 triangles.
limitations: At 524 triangles the shaped back facets under grazing light.
Shelves are fixed and cannot be re-spaced without editing.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Steel can with a hinged lid, folding carry handle, latch and a rubber-gasket end plate with a recessed circular seal. Stencilled 200 CARTRIDGES 7.62 MM markings are generic military specification text with no manufacturer. Rust and olive paint wear are consistent across every orbit. 4.4k tris.
limitations: Lid is modelled closed and latched.
Stencil text is specific to 7.62 mm ammunition; retouch it for a different calibre.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Wide brass pot with a genuinely hollow copper-lined interior, confirmed in the top view, two modelled side lugs and a rolled rim. The copper interior and tarnished brass exterior read as clearly different metals in every orbit, and the bottom view shows a properly closed base. 3.3k tris.
limitations: Interior copper is highly reflective and needs an environment map.
